description: Frontend actions required by the Aria intent set that do not exist yet. Existing actions are listed for reference and must keep their current names. All action names, param names and enum values here are the canonical ones used by intents.json, dialogues.json and test_set.json.

reply_mode.silent: Perform the action with no speech. An earcon/visual pulse is enough (used for scroll, zoom, paging, which customers repeat quickly).
reply_mode.full: A full reply of up to 25 words, read aloud.

conventions.confirmation_flow: When requires_confirmation is true, the backend does NOT dispatch the action directly. It dispatches show_confirmation with the pending action, stores it in conversation_state.pending_confirmation, and dispatches the real action only after confirm_pending_action. cancel_pending_action or any unrelated intent clears it. Pending confirmations expire after 20 seconds.
conventions.item_resolution: Intents carry an item_reference slot. The backend resolves it against conversation_state.last_shown (and the highlighted item) to a concrete item_id BEFORE dispatching. The frontend always receives item_id strings, never raw phrases.
conventions.role_enforcement: Actions with allowed_roles ['staff'] are rejected by the backend for customer sessions; Aria replies with the refusal text and offers request_staff_assistance.

item_id.description: Catalog item id resolved by the backend from an item_reference.

item_reference.description: Spoken reference to an on-screen item. Resolved server-side to item_id.
item_reference.deictic_rule: 'this'/'that' = currently highlighted item, else the most recently mentioned item, else ask.
item_reference.ambiguity_rule: If more than one item matches (e.g. two red items), Aria asks a missing_slot question listing up to 3 candidates by position.

new_actions.name: go_back
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Browser-style history back within the app. If an item detail or cart drawer is open, closes it first instead of leaving the page. On the first page of the session, no-op.

not_possible: This is the first screen, so there's nothing to go back to.

new_actions.name: go_forward
new_actions.ui_behaviour: History forward. No-op if there is no forward entry.

not_possible: There's no page ahead. Want me to open something specific?

new_actions.name: refresh_page
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Re-fetches data for the current page without a full browser reload. Conversation state, cart and liked items are preserved.

not_possible: I couldn't refresh right now. Let me call a staff member if it keeps happening.

new_actions.name: toggle_sidebar
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens or closes the left sidebar menu. When opened by voice, menu items are read-highlighted so the customer can say a page name next.

success: Menu is open. Which page would you like?
Menu khul gaya, kaunsa page kholein?
not_possible: The menu is already open.

new_actions.name: set_aria_panel
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Controls the Aria overlay. 'close' hides the panel but keeps listening in hands-free mode; Aria can be reopened by voice.

success: Panel minimised. Just call me when you need me.

new_actions.name: set_hands_free
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Turns continuous listening on/off. When turned off, the mirror shows a large on-screen hint telling the customer to say the wake phrase 'Hey Aria' (wake-word detection stays active so the mirror remains touchless).

success: Hands-free is off. Say 'Hey Aria' when you need me.

new_actions.name: set_mic_recording
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Starts or stops a single push-to-talk recording when hands-free is off. Shows the live mic indicator.

not_possible: The microphone isn't available right now. A staff member can help.

new_actions.name: set_listening_mode
new_actions.ui_behaviour: 'sleep' stops processing speech except the wake phrase and dims the Aria orb. 'awake' resumes. Used for 'Aria, sleep' / 'wake up'.

success: Okay, I'll stay quiet. Say 'Hey Aria' to wake me.
I'm awake! How can I help?
Theek hai, 'Hey Aria' bolna jab zaroorat ho.

new_actions.name: set_notifications_panel
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens or closes the top-bar notifications dropdown. When opened by voice, Aria reads the newest notification title.

not_possible: You don't have any notifications right now.

new_actions.name: set_theme
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Sets an explicit theme (unlike toggle_theme which flips it). If already in that mode, no-op with a reply.

not_possible: It's already in that mode.

new_actions.name: set_zoom
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Accessibility zoom of the whole UI in 20% steps (80-200%). 'level' sets an exact value. Does not affect the try-on camera zoom (see set_tryon_zoom).

not_possible: That's already the largest size.
That's already the smallest size.

new_actions.name: set_captions
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Shows Aria's replies as large on-screen captions (for customers who prefer reading). Sets conversation_state.accessibility_hearing_text_pref.

success: I'll show everything I say as text too.

new_actions.name: scroll
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Smooth-scrolls the main content area (never the Aria panel). small=25% of viewport, medium=60%, large=150%, page=100%. At a limit, no-op and reply.

not_possible: You're at the bottom already. Want more options?
You're already at the top.

new_actions.name: scroll_to
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Jumps to the very top or bottom of the main content area.

new_actions.name: scroll_to_section

section.description: Section or type-group name, e.g. 'Sarees', 'Heels', 'Based on your scan', 'Best Colors'.

new_actions.ui_behaviour: Scrolls so the named section (or the next/previous section header) is at the top and briefly highlights its header. Exactly one of section or direction must be given.

not_possible: I don't see a {section} section here. Want me to search for it?

new_actions.name: paginate
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Moves to the next/previous page of a paginated product or request list and updates conversation_state.last_shown.

success: Going back to the previous set.
not_possible: That's the last page. Want something different?
You're on the first page.

new_actions.name: load_more
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Appends more results to the current list (infinite-scroll style), scrolls to the first new item and appends ids to last_shown.

not_possible: That's everything for these filters. Shall I widen the search?

new_actions.name: stop_speaking
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Immediately stops TTS playback and clears the speech queue. Listening continues. Must be handled client-side with barge-in priority (no backend round trip needed).

new_actions.name: set_speech_rate
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Adjusts Edge-TTS rate in steps of 15% (range -45% to +30%). Persists for the session; 'slower' also triggers repeat_last_reply at the new rate.

not_possible: That's my slowest speed. I can also show my replies as text.

new_actions.name: set_voice_volume
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Changes Aria's output volume by 15% steps or to an exact level (minimum 10% so the customer can still hear confirmations). Exactly one of change or level.

not_possible: That's my loudest. A staff member can turn up the speaker for you.

new_actions.name: set_voice_mute
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Mutes TTS output; replies still appear as on-screen captions (set_captions forced on). Listening continues.

success: I'll reply in text on screen.

new_actions.name: show_help

screen.description: Screen id; defaults to the current screen.

new_actions.ui_behaviour: Shows a large card of 6-8 example voice commands for the current screen (from intents.json utterances) plus 3 global ones. Aria reads the top 3.

success: You can say things like 'show me sarees', 'like the second one', or 'add this to cart'.
Aap bol sakte hain: 'saree dikhao', 'doosra wala pasand hai', ya 'cart mein daalo'.

new_actions.name: show_confirmation

pending_action.description: {type, params} of the action awaiting confirmation.

prompt.description: The question Aria speaks and shows.

new_actions.ui_behaviour: Shows a large Yes / No banner with the prompt and a 20-second countdown. Never executes anything itself.

new_actions.name: confirm_pending_action
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Executes conversation_state.pending_confirmation and clears it. If nothing is pending, no-op.

not_possible: There's nothing waiting for a yes right now. What would you like to do?

new_actions.name: cancel_pending_action
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Clears conversation_state.pending_confirmation and hides the confirmation banner. Also cancels an in-progress multi-step flow (e.g. a countdown photo).

not_possible: Nothing to cancel right now.

new_actions.name: undo_last_action
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Reverts the most recent reversible state change (filter set, like/unlike, add/remove cart item, outfit slot change, quantity change). Keeps a stack of the last 5. Cannot undo navigation (use go_back) or save_outfit.

success: I've put it back the way it was.
not_possible: There's nothing I can undo there. Want me to go back instead?

new_actions.name: reset_session
new_actions.ui_behaviour: 'Start over': clears conversation_state preferences, filters, liked items and outfit builder; keeps the scan unless keep_scan=false. Cart is kept unless the customer also asks to empty it. Returns to dashboard.

success: Fresh start! What are we shopping for today?
Chaliye, shuru se karte hain. Kis mauke ke liye dekh rahe hain?

new_actions.confirmation_prompt: Start over? Your preferences, favourites and outfit will be cleared.

new_actions.name: focus_item
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Highlights the item card (glow border), scrolls it into view and sets it as the deictic target for 'this one'. Relative references (next/previous) are resolved by the backend from the current highlight.

not_possible: That's the last one on screen. Want to see more?
I can't find that one. Could you say its number?

new_actions.name: close_item_detail
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Closes the open item detail view and returns to the list with the same scroll position and highlight.

new_actions.name: zoom_item_image
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens the item image in a large lightbox and zooms 2x per step (max 4x). 'reset' returns to fit-to-screen.

not_possible: That's the closest view I have.

new_actions.name: expand_explanation
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Expands/collapses the 'Why AI picked this' panel on the card. Used alongside the explain_recommendation tool, whose output Aria reads aloud.

not_possible: I don't have an explanation for that one yet.

new_actions.name: compare_items
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens a side-by-side comparison panel (image, colour, fabric, occasion tags, match score; price only if present in catalog data). Aria summarises the main difference.

success: Here they are side by side. {comparison_summary}
not_possible: I need two items to compare. Which two — say their numbers?

new_actions.name: refresh_recommendations
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Re-runs recommend_clothes with current state. 'more_like' biases toward the anchor item's colour/style; 'different' excludes the current last_shown styles. Replaces the list and resets highlight.

success: Here's a fresh set for you.
not_possible: I couldn't find more like that. Want me to loosen a filter?

new_actions.name: like_item
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Fills the heart icon on the card (Recommendations 'like' and Shopping 'wishlist' are the same list) and adds the id to conversation_state.liked_items. Liking an already-liked item is a no-op with a reply.

not_possible: It's already in your favourites.
There's nothing on screen to like yet. Want to see some options?

new_actions.name: unlike_item
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Empties the heart and removes the id from liked_items. Reversible via undo_last_action, so no confirmation.

not_possible: That one isn't in your favourites.

new_actions.name: show_liked
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens the favourites view (a filtered product grid of liked_items) and sets last_shown to it.

not_possible: You haven't liked anything yet. Just say 'like this one' when something catches your eye.

new_actions.name: clear_liked
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Removes all liked items.

not_possible: Your favourites list is already empty.

new_actions.name: open_cart
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens the cart drawer from any screen (navigates to Shopping if the drawer is only available there).

not_possible: Your cart is empty right now. Want some suggestions?

new_actions.name: close_cart
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Closes the cart drawer and returns focus to the page behind it.

new_actions.name: remove_from_cart
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Removes the line item entirely. Opens the cart drawer if closed so the customer sees the change.

not_possible: That item isn't in your cart.

new_actions.name: set_cart_quantity
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Sets an exact quantity or steps it by +/-1 (the +/- buttons). Exactly one of quantity or delta. A result of 0 is converted to remove_from_cart (with its confirmation). Quantity above stock is capped by the backend.

not_possible: That item isn't in your cart yet. Shall I add it?
I can only set up to 10 here — staff can help with bulk orders.

new_actions.name: clear_cart
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Removes every line item and shows the empty-cart state.
new_actions.confirmation_prompt: Remove all {count} items from your cart?

not_possible: Your cart is already empty.

new_actions.name: read_cart_summary
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Briefly pulses the cart badge/total. Aria reads the requested value exactly as computed by the backend from catalog prices (never estimated).

success: You have {count} items in your cart.
not_possible: Your cart is empty.

new_actions.name: reserve_item
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Clicks 'Reserve' on the card: creates a hold request for staff (uses request_staff_assistance with reason 'reserve'). Hold duration and stock are confirmed by staff, never promised by Aria.

success: I've asked the team to hold it for you. A staff member will confirm availability.
Staff ko reserve karne ke liye bata diya hai.
not_possible: I couldn't place that request. Let me call someone over.

new_actions.name: send_to_fitting_room
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Creates a 'trial room' staff request listing the items and sizes, shows a ticket card with a request number.

success: Done! A staff member will bring these to a trial room for you.
Trial room ke liye request bhej di hai.
not_possible: There's nothing to send yet. Add something to your cart first?

new_actions.name: set_department
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Switches 'Range: Women's | Men's' and reloads results. Overrides the scan-detected department for this session only.

not_possible: You're already in that range.

new_actions.name: set_category_filter
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Selects the category chip and reloads results.

not_possible: No {category} items match right now. Try another occasion?

new_actions.name: set_occasion_filter
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Selects the occasion chip, reloads results, and writes conversation_state.occasion.

new_actions.name: set_include_filter
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Sets the 'What should I include?' chips. 'everything' selects all. Re-runs recommend_clothes with the include list.

new_actions.name: set_filter

value.description: price: {min,max} in INR; color/fabric/pattern: list[string] from entities.json; size: string.

new_actions.ui_behaviour: Applies a non-chip filter, shows it as a removable filter pill, and reloads results. Writes the matching conversation_state field (budget, color_preferences, size...).

not_possible: Nothing matches that. Shall I relax the {filter} a little?

new_actions.name: set_sort
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Re-orders the current list and resets highlight to the first item.

new_actions.name: clear_filters
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Removes one filter or all filters (department falls back to the scan value). Reversible via undo_last_action.

not_possible: There aren't any filters on right now.

new_actions.name: search

refine.description: true = narrow the current results instead of replacing the query.

new_actions.ui_behaviour: Types the query into the top-bar search box, runs search_inventory, navigates to Shopping results and sets last_shown.

not_possible: I couldn't find {query}. Want to try something similar?

new_actions.name: clear_search
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Empties the search box and restores the unfiltered Shopping grid.

not_possible: The search box is already empty.

new_actions.name: cancel_scan
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Stops an in-progress scan, discards partial results and shows the start screen. Previous completed scan (if any) is kept.

success: Scan stopped. Say 'start scan' whenever you're ready.
not_possible: There's no scan running right now.

new_actions.name: read_scan_status
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Answers 'am I standing right?' / 'is it done?'. Pulses the framing guide; Aria gives one concrete correction from the pose detector (step closer, step back, move left, raise arms slightly).

success: Please take one small step back.
not_possible: The scan hasn't started yet. Say 'start scan' when you're ready.

new_actions.name: highlight_insight
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Scrolls to and highlights the matching insight card while Aria explains it (data from get_body_profile / get_color_palette). Explanations are always neutral-positive.

not_possible: I don't have scan results yet. Shall we do a quick scan?

new_actions.name: correct_profile_field
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Overrides a scan value with the customer's stated value (marked 'you told us' instead of a confidence tag) and refreshes recommendations. Customer-stated values always win over scan values.

not_possible: I didn't catch the value. Could you say it again?

new_actions.name: open_trending_style
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens Recommendations pre-filtered toward the selected trend and writes it to conversation_state.style_archetype.

new_actions.name: add_item_to_outfit
new_actions.ui_behaviour: The 'Add to Outfit' card button: places the item into the matching Outfit Builder slot (by its category) without leaving the page; replaces any item already in that slot.

success: Added to your outfit as the {slot}.
not_possible: That type of item doesn't fit an outfit slot yet.

new_actions.name: auto_complete_outfit
new_actions.ui_behaviour: The 'AI outfit' button: calls complete_outfit and fills only the empty slots, then updates completion % and AI match score.

success: Done! I've filled the rest. Your match score is {score} percent.
not_possible: Pick at least one piece first, and I'll build around it.

new_actions.name: clear_outfit
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Empties all outfit slots and the name field.
new_actions.confirmation_prompt: Clear the whole outfit and start again?

not_possible: The outfit is already empty.

new_actions.name: read_outfit_stats
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Pulses the stats panel; Aria reads the requested values.

success: You've picked {items} pieces, it's {completion} percent complete, with a {score} percent match.
not_possible: There's nothing in the outfit yet.

new_actions.name: set_lighting
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Switches the try-on lighting mode.

new_actions.name: set_tryon_zoom
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Moves the camera zoom slider by 0.25x steps or to an exact level.

not_possible: That's the maximum zoom.

new_actions.name: flip_camera
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Mirrors/un-mirrors the camera view.

new_actions.name: capture_photo
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Shows a large on-screen countdown (spoken '3, 2, 1') then captures. Photo stays on the mirror only; it is not saved or sent anywhere unless the customer asks staff.

success: Photo ready. Want to keep it or retake?
not_possible: The camera isn't ready. Give it a second.

new_actions.name: retake_photo
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Discards the current captured photo and immediately starts a new countdown capture. Retake implies the customer wants a new photo, so no confirmation.

new_actions.name: dismiss_photo
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Deletes the captured photo and returns to the live view.

not_possible: There's no photo to delete.

new_actions.name: rate_item
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Sets thumbs and/or stars on a recommendation. Thumbs down adds the item to disliked_items and, if a reason is given, updates the matching preference (e.g. disliked_colors, embellishment_level).

success: Got it — I'll show less like that.
not_possible: Stars go from 1 to 5. How many would you give it?

new_actions.name: rate_session
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Sets the overall rating widget.

new_actions.name: toggle_style_tag
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Turns a style-preference tag on/off and writes it to conversation_state.style_archetype list.

not_possible: I don't see a {tag} tag. The options are on screen.

new_actions.name: staff_login_start
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens the chosen sign-in flow. Passwords are NEVER accepted by voice (spoken passwords are audible to bystanders); staff type them on the staff keypad or use Google. Customers are refused.

success: Opening sign-in. Please type your password on the keypad, not out loud.
not_possible: Sign-in is for store staff only. Shall I call someone to help you?

new_actions.name: set_setting

value.description: bool for toggles; language code for display_language.

new_actions.ui_behaviour: Flips a settings toggle or sets the display language dropdown. Staff only.

not_possible: Settings are for store staff only. I can call someone if you need help.

new_actions.name: open_account_security
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Opens the change-password or 2FA dialog for keypad entry. No values are taken by voice.

success: Opened. Please complete it on the keypad.
not_possible: That's a staff-only setting.

new_actions.name: delete_account
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Danger zone. Opens the delete-account dialog; final deletion also requires staff keypad re-authentication in the UI. Voice can never complete it alone.
new_actions.confirmation_prompt: This permanently deletes the account. Are you sure?

success: Please confirm with your password on the keypad to finish.
not_possible: That's a staff-only setting.

new_actions.name: refresh_staff_requests
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Reloads the request queue.

new_actions.name: set_staff_request_tab
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Switches between Pending and All tabs.

new_actions.name: acknowledge_request
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Marks the request acknowledged and notifies the customer's mirror that help is on the way.

success: Acknowledged. The customer has been told you're coming.
not_possible: I can't find that request.

new_actions.name: resolve_request
new_actions.ui_behaviour: Marks the request resolved and moves it out of Pending.

not_possible: I can't find that request.

changes_to_existing_actions.name: admin_logout
changes_to_existing_actions.change: Set requires_confirmation true and allowed_roles ['staff'] in the intent layer; dispatch via show_confirmation first.

changes_to_existing_actions.name: end_conversation
changes_to_existing_actions.change: On end, also clear session state (preferences, liked items, outfit, captured photo) so the next customer starts fresh; cart is handed to staff if non-empty.

changes_to_existing_actions.name: escalate_to_staff
changes_to_existing_actions.change: Accept an optional {reason} param matching request types: discount, payment, refund, complaint, stock_issue, special_request, trial_room, alteration, gift_wrap, size_check, other.

changes_to_existing_actions.name: navigate
changes_to_existing_actions.change: Param 'page' uses the page enum in param_types; 'home' maps to dashboard; staff-only pages (settings, staff_requests) are refused for customers.
